# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash_10-steps250-compact64k

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`solo` with 250 steps and compaction raised from 28K to 64K tokens. One `solo` agent has to keep both features in a single context, so this tests whether giving it more room before summarizing helps. 64K is roughly what the two `coop` agents have together at 28K each.

## Results

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| Setting | `solo`, 1 agent per pair |
| Subset | `flash_10` (10 pairs) |
| Step limit | 250 per agent |
| Compaction | at 64K tokens |
| Passed | 7/10 (70%) |
| Agents stopped at the step limit | 3 |
| Merge conflicts | 0 |
| Agent errors | 0 |
| Cost | `$19.63` (`$1.96` per pair) |
| Wall time | 128 min |

## Observations

- 7/10, at about the same cost as 250 steps with 28K compaction (`$19.63` vs. `$18.75`), because agents that finished stopped early.
- Every agent that submitted passed both features. They finished in 96 to 229 steps and summarized their context only 2 to 8 times.
- The 3 failures were stopped at step 250 with nothing pushed. In `pillow_task/290` the agent had edited code for both features and was checking its changes when it was stopped. In `dspy_task/8394` and `pallets_jinja_task/1559` the agents kept printing very large command outputs and never started editing.
